title: Safety and Efficacy of scAAV9/AGA Gene Therapy in Participants With Aspartylglucosaminuria (AGU)
official: An Open-Label, Single Center, Phase 1/2 Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of DANAGALEX (scAAV9/AGA) in Participants With Aspartylglucosaminuria (AGU)
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if the treatment is a safe, tolerable, and efficacious treatment for adults and children with Aspartylglucosaminuria (AGU).

sites.f: Louisiana State University Health Sciences Center
